name: OmaCanon
author: Dankestrick
description: Plug in a Canon camera by USB and its new photos come over to Pictures/Canon, sorted by day. Go through them on big previews, trash the bad ones, and keep the rest in the folder or add them to OmaRAW with tags and an album.

dependencies.name: gphoto2
dependencies.why: Talks to the camera over USB

dependencies.name: python
dependencies.why: Runs the helper that brings the photos over

dependencies.name: Pillow
dependencies.why: Makes the previews from each photo

dependencies.name: setpriv
dependencies.why: Ends a download together with the shell
